descriptionChirho: To cause thunder, used of God producing thunder as a theophanic or meteorological act (Hifil causative stem).
To roar or thunder, used of the sea or natural phenomena making a loud, rumbling sound (Qal stem).
To be troubled, disturbed, or agitated, describing an emotional or physical state of trembling or distress (Qal stem).

labelChirho: Hifil: to cause to tremble, provoke
descriptionChirho: To cause someone to tremble or to provoke agitation, the causative counterpart of the Qal 'be troubled' sense (Hifil stem).
